description.narrative: Programmet syftar till att stärka statistikmyndighetens kapacitet att producera statistik av god kvalitet, samt att bidra till ökad tillgänglighet i linje med användarnas behov, samt att att bidra till anpassning till EU:s standarder.

The project aims to improve SSO’s overall capacity to produce and disseminate quality statistics, to provide an increased availability of statistics in accordance with the needs of current and future users, as well as the requirements of the EU acquis in statistics.
The objective is enhanced capacity to produce statistics in line with user needs and EU requirements.

- An international user conference for the PxWeb toll (a software used for publishing and exploring statistical data online) was jointly hosted by SSO and Statistics Sweden in Skopje on November 7 8, with 30 attendees on-site and over 100 persons participating online, from all together 27 countries. (Annual report 2024)
- A new training center within SSOs premises was launched i 2025. The training center will allow for training of SSOs staff in as well as for other members of the national statistical system. (Not reported yet but Sida attended the launch)
- A new website, developed during the previous phase, was launched April 2025. (Not reported yet but Sida attended the launch)
- The project has continued to support the implementation and use of a product-based planning and monitoring system. During the autumn the system was used for planning for 2025. (Annual report 2024)
- Draft guidelines for internal communication have been produced. (ibid)
- Steps towards an enhanced methodological capacity has been taken. A group of employees who will make up the methodology support group has been appointed and will be conducting training in basic statistical methodology during 2025. (ibid)
- The development of an Employment Register was finalised during the first project phase, and a process is in place to make the data available for statistics production. During this first period statistical products that can utilise the Employment Register, and their relations, has been identified. (ibid)
- As a first step towards a policy for IT tools and systems an inventory of present IT tools and systems has been initialized through an in-house survey. (ibid)
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
